summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival game whose shared player systems carry exploration, combat, loot and progression through Level 0, the Habitable Zone, utility halls and the Electrical Station. Each level combines a seeded procedural layout and simulation with shared combat, inventory, HUD and creature code; player state persists across places, while place state schedules local world activity.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze and hub; authored cells complement the generated maze, loot, threats and now breakable office furniture/walls.
places/level1 (3D) - Habitable Zone and M.E.G. camp; sim manages its environment, camp agents, supplies and encounters.
places/level2 (3D) - Abandoned Utility Halls and Survivor camp; sim builds the seeded halls/rooms, supplies and NPCs, and opens the Level 3 threshold.
places/level3 (3D) - Electrical Station; sim builds its seeded maze, Base Gamma checkpoint, hazards, loot, hounds and deathmoth swarms.
places/debug (3D) - isolated combat and loot test room; authored cells hold weapon/item stations, enemy pens and test stands.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry/default place and shared camera, player, input, HUD and nametag wiring; includes the BUILD action.
templates/player.js - ordered player behavior chain: locomotion, player, interact, build, noclip, stats, critter.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - look input and camera yaw/pitch; movement, gaze checks, targeting and viewmodel use its direction/state.
places/main/sim.js, places/level1/sim.js, places/level2/sim.js, places/level3/sim.js - per-place simulation roots; each seeds local geometry/contents and maintains its local actors or schedules.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells - place mode, spawn/atmosphere settings and authored cell contents; Level 0, Level 1 and debug also use authored cells.
scripts/ui.js + scripts/loot-ui.js + scripts/build-ui.js + scripts/stats-ui.js + scripts/noclip-ui.js - HUD composition for prompts/inventory, building, HALOGEN sheet and noclip.
shared: scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/data/level0.yml; scripts/lib/level1.js and level2.js with their data - level-specific grid/layout contracts reused by simulation, geometry and gameplay.

scripts/lib/level3.js + scripts/lib/data/level3.yml + scripts/lib/maze3path.js - deterministic 26×26 Electrical Station grid, zones/blocks/hazards and open-edge routing for geometry, sim, player, hounds and moths.
scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml + scripts/lib/weapons.js; weapon-look.js, weapon-prof.js and weapon-geo.js - shared weapon definitions, variants and fitted meshes for pickups, viewmodels and NPCs.
scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/loot3.js - common token vocabulary and general loot, with Level 3-specific crate tables, pages, garments and weapons.
scripts/lib/clothes.js + clothes.yml; scripts/lib/stats.js - apparel tokens/slots/armor and HALOGEN derivations reused by player, NPC combat, loot and UI.
scripts/lib/breakables.js + breakables.yml - damage, material/tool harvest rolls, rubble and Level 0 wall synchronization; used by player attacks and main simulation.
scripts/critter2-geo.js + scripts/meg-agent.js - procedural avatar and shared NPC movement/combat/talk/death behavior for M.E.G., Survivors and Gamma agents.
scripts/lib/npc-talk.js + data/talk.yml and shops.yml - standalone dialogue/reply, skill-check and trading policy helpers; no active caller is wired in the current tree.
notableExports: places/main/sim.js, places/level1/sim.js, places/level2/sim.js, places/level3/sim.js and places/debug/sim.js - cadence and tick; place simulations own world setup and ticking.
scripts/lib/level3.js - grid dimensions/constants, cell and zone queries, openings, block/hazard lists, BACK/LIFT exits and L3_NAMES; scripts/lib/maze3path.js - stepToward, cellNear.
scripts/lib/breakables.js - strike, damageEntity, damageWall, rollDrops, spawnRubble, syncLevel0 and material/tool helpers.
scripts/build.js - onInput, update for build-mode placement and local ghost; scripts/build-ui.js - buildUi.
scripts/lib/loot3.js - rollWeaponL3, rollTableL3, rollItemL3, spawnCrateL3; scripts/deathmoths.js - update.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, takeToken, onInput, reload callbacks, pumpRack, update; scripts/interact.js - openLoot, talk, onInput, update.
scripts/lib/items.js - itemsOf, tokenOf, describe and L2 token constants; scripts/lib/clothes.js and scripts/lib/stats.js - apparel and HALOGEN helpers.
scripts/ui.js - default render and plyUpload; scripts/loot-ui.js, scripts/build-ui.js and scripts/stats-ui.js - loot, build and stats panels.
ownership: scripts/player.js - player.state owns level/XP, health/survival, visited cells/zones, kills/deaths, weapon inventory/equipment/ammo/condition, clothes, compass charges and Level 3 consumable/page fields.
scripts/stats.js - player.state owns HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags, schema version, sheetOpen and target; initializes/migrates the sheet and spends points.

scripts/build.js + scripts/player.js - player.state.scrap counts building materials; building/buildRot/buildLast drive selected build piece and rotation; session holds the preview ghost/forward direction.
scripts/interact.js - player focus, loot menu and notices; containers own item-token lists, lock/scavenged fields; NPCs own talk/attitude fields and doors own lock/open.
scripts/critter.js - player.state.look owns appearance/worn slots and outfits preserve saved looks; avatar scratch is local/session state.
place simulations - each place.state owns seeded flags and its local respawn/refill/hazard schedule; Level 3 additionally tracks generator overloads, line output and actor managers.
scripts/lib/breakables.js - Level 0 wall health/broken keys live in place.state; breakable entities own material, hp/maxHp, name and optional contents.

scripts/smilers.js, lurkers.js, hounds.js, stealers.js, deathmoths.js and meg-agent.js - creature/NPC entity state owns health/death, rolled stats, loot and behavior flags; path/target scratch is session-local.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js chain: locomotion reads prior movement; player owns movement/survival/combat; interact handles use; build handles build input; noclip handles arrival/exit; stats handles sheet; critter handles avatar.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js owns yaw/pitch; movement, enemy gaze/target checks and viewmodel pose consume camera direction/state.
Level 0 exit in scripts/player.js → Level 1; Level 1 onward threshold → Level 2; Level 2's l2-to-l3 trigger → Level 3; Level 3 BACK trigger → Level 2 via scripts/level-door.js.

interact.js focus/E → container token list and scripts/player.js takeToken → inventory/player.state; scripts/ui.js composes loot-ui.js prompts/menus and routes menu actions back to player/interact handlers.
place simulations and enemy deaths → scripts/lib/loot.js or loot3.js → weapon registry/clothing/token drops → floor entities or searchable containers.
player.js attack → scripts/lib/breakables.js strike → entity hp or Level 0 wall hp/broken entries; broken material drops become rubble containers, while main/sim syncs regenerated wall geometry.

BUILD action → scripts/build.js selects, rotates and places pieces from breakables.yml, spends player.state.scrap and spawns breakable entities; build-ui.js renders costs and selection through scripts/ui.js.
scripts/lib/level3.js layout/data → places/level3/sim.js geometry, checkpoints, sludge/live boxes, generator and line schedules; player.js reads Level 3 zone sanity settings.
Level 3 sim → scripts/hounds.js and scripts/deathmoths.js managers → hound/moth entities; scripts/lib/maze3path.js routes creatures along actual open Level 3 edges.

Level 3 loot3 tables → page/weapon/item tokens → player.js takeToken; page collection/read state is rendered by scripts/ui.js, firesalt affects melee damage and stun_baton writes stunUntil for hounds.
scripts/player.js useCompass → scripts/lib/compass.js chooses place exits including Level 3 BACK/LIFT and writes compassRead; scripts/ui.js displays timed bearing/readout.
scripts/lib/npc-talk.js reads talk.yml/shops.yml and defines dialogue/trading helpers, but no current player behavior calls it; camp chatter remains a separate chatter.js → NPC state.line → HUD flow.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* - repeated authored fluorescent fixtures and red-zone variants; selected cell also has flicker-wall markings, sound and local flicker/light state.
scripts/smilers.js and lurkers.js - parallel Level 0 enemy loops share targeting, maze checks, bites/deaths and rolled stats, with distinct gaze/light/sanity responses.
scripts/hounds.js + hound-geo.js - shared Level 1/2/3 hound AI and model; safe zones and path grids vary by place, Level 3 brigades use Level 3 maze routing and stun state.
scripts/meg-agent.js + critter2-geo.js - common NPC behavior/avatar varies by species/look, role, voice, weapon and place; used by M.E.G., Survivors and Base Gamma.
scripts/lib/weapons.js + weapon-look.js + weapon-prof.js + weapon-geo.js + viewmodel-geo.js - weapon kinds reuse fitted bodies with variant stats/tint/overlays and viewmodel framing.
scripts/build-geo.js + breakables.yml - built structures, Level 0 office furniture, rubble and breakable props share geometry/crack stages while material, dimensions, hp and harvest outcomes vary.
scripts/lib/loot.js and loot3.js - common pickup/container patterns with place-specific weighted tables; Level 3 adds richer finds, notebook pages and station weapons.
scripts/deathmoths.js + templates/deathmoths.js - one Level 3 manager steers multiple swarms; template carries swarm body/look/sound while swarms vary by home and current target.
probableOrphans: scripts/l2-door.js - exports a door-leaf swing animation, but no current tree/package reference to the script is visible.
scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js - no active place uses it; place terrain is off.
scripts/flower.js, scripts/grass.js, scripts/grass-look.js and scripts/reed.js - no active terrain layers or placed references are visible; terrain is off.
migrationNotes: Grid contracts differ by level: Level 0 is 56×56 at 4 m with hub cells 26–29; Level 1 is 30×30 at 8 m; Level 2 is 24×24 at 5 m; Level 3 is 26×26 at 4 m. Keep geometry, zones, spawn/exit logic and route helpers aligned to their own grid.

Player behavior order is intentional: humanoid-locomotion.js before player.js, then interact.js, build.js, noclip.js, stats.js and critter.js; locomotion reads movement before player control writes velocity.
Weapon ids remain kind or kind~variant across inventory, condition, magazines and entities; use baseOf only where base-kind framing/behavior is intended.

Building scrap is a per-kind player.state.scrap object, unlike comma-separated inventory/container tokens; breakables need tag plus state.mat/hp/maxHp, and Level 0 wall hp/broken state is separate place.state data.

Level-specific zone keys are prefixed l1_/l2_/l3_; Level 3 generation is seeded from level3.yml, Gamma is safe, and LIFT is currently only a dead freight elevator/sign rather than an implemented Level 4 crossing.

HALOGEN stores seven comma-separated attributes and thirteen spent skill values (sver=2); clothing uses cloth:<slot>:<kind>:<hex>, and Level 3 page ownership is a separate comma-separated pages field.
